description: Transvaalbuurt 1929 portiek blocks of Tugelaweg 91-120: 14 m stair blocks of a dark purple-brown brick ground storey (to 4.0 m) under three cream-rendered storeys and a flat roof run out as a deep white eaves slab (fascia 13.0-13.4 m); one grey rendered stair panel about 2 m wide over the portiek door on the block's middle axis, a small square stair light per storey in it; either side a narrow window and a wide white band window of four or five lights under a top-light row, and at both ends a balcony door with a projecting iron balcony on storeys 1-3

match.note: BAG 1929 on both Tugelaweg faces (91-112, 113-120); every stair block 14.0-15.0 m, 3DBAG eaves 12.9-13.0 m and bouwlagen 5 (the eaves slab counts), roof max 17.2-18.3 m (roof plant and stair heads, not a pitched roof). The cream render reads stucco on the 2020-04-29 strip (wall #b2a98f-#bbb39c raw), which no brick 1928-1931 block of the buurt does (Schalk Burgerstraat 45-131, Afrikanerplein 1-55, Albert Luthulistraat 6-32 are brick): stucco and wall are the criteria that keep the type off them. The end pands 91-92 (15.7 m, eaves 9.9 m: the three-storey corner wing) and 119-120 (eaves 9.9 m) fall outside the storey count and stay with the city tier.

flat-overhang.note: Tugelaweg 95-96 (075050): the flat roof's white eaves slab 13.0-13.4 m, grey soffit, about 0.9 m out (seen end-on over the corner wing of 91-92)

portiek.note: the portiek door (red-brown timber, 1.0 m) under the grey panel, a dark brick hood over it at 3.6-4.0 m; mailboxes either side

rhythm.bays: balcony door, band window, narrow window, stair panel, narrow window, band window, balcony door
rhythm.identicalBays: no: band windows 3 m, narrow windows 1.1 m, the stair axis a small light
rhythm.windowsPerStorey: ground: windows + portiek door | 1-3: balcony door + band window + window + stair light + window + band window + balcony door
rhythm.groundFloor: dark brick, the portiek door under the stair panel, band windows either side
rhythm.roofline: flat, a deep white eaves slab

evidence.citation: strip.jpg 2020-04-29 at 40 px/m, 1 m grid on 95-96 (075050, 13.9 m): dark brick to 4.0 m, ground windows 1.7-3.4 m; window rows 5.0-6.35, 7.8-9.05, 10.6-11.95 m (2.8 m pitch); eaves slab 13.0-13.4 m; grey panel 2.0 m wide on the stair axis from 4.0 m to the slab; band windows 3.0-3.1 m, narrow windows 1.1-1.3 m, balcony doors with iron balconies at the block ends (balcony pairs at the party walls of 93-94/95-96 and 95-96/97-98). Cream #b8b097, panel #9a9b94, brick #403d3c raw (fascia #dde4dd: x1/0.9 for the type palette)
strip.jpg 2020-04-29: the same block on 113-118, grey stair panels at a 14 m pitch

schemaLimits: the stair panel's paired slit lights per half landing are drawn as one small light per storey on the stair axis
the band windows' top-light rows of small panes and the narrow side lights are a plain top light
the ground storey's orange header specks in the dark brick are not drawn
BAG cuts the row so that the stair panel sits 1-1.8 m off the pand centre on some blocks (95-96 at 5.2 m of 13.9 m); the type draws it centred
notes: Kit (2026-11-01, #153): paintedStoreys.panels draws the grey stair panel over the cream render (fit.ts paintedPanelBlocks).
